messages:
mia-sales: Help! Prospect ran our quick POC and sees 403 invalid_org_binding + unclear "insufficient_scopes" on another endpoint. Demo in 40m, need triage.

kevin-ps: What calls did they run and which key are they using?

mia-sales: They used sk_demo_winco22 for generate and sk_demo_winco22 for embeddings; snippet shows curl with only Authorization header. No org header.

ana-eng: Two likely issues: 1) if key is org-bound and they accidentally passed an org header mismatched -> invalid_org_binding. 2) if embeddings endpoint requires "embed" scope and key only has "generate" -> insufficient_scopes. We'll inspect metadata.

raj-ops: Inspecting key now: `redwood keys inspect sk_demo_winco22` -> {"key":"sk_demo_winco22","org_id":"org-winco-demo","scopes":["generate"],"bound":true} (checked by raj-ops).

kevin-ps: That explains both: bound=true -> 403 if they set wrong X-Redwood-Org; and missing "embed" scope causes 403/insufficient_scopes on embeddings.

mia-sales: They did try embeddings. They thought the demo key covered all endpoints. Can we quickly issue a demo key with both scopes, or advise them to only call generate?

ana-eng: Fastest: tell them to limit to generate for this demo. If they must demo embeddings, ops can create short-lived key with scopes ["generate","embed"] but note audit and approval required. Also ask them to remove any X-Redwood-Org header to avoid binding mismatch.

raj-ops: I can create sk_temp_winco_multi (30m) with both scopes and unbound flag if you want. Creating now if you confirm.

kevin-ps: Do it. Also, can you paste the CLI command we can give the customer to confirm what scopes are on a key? Helpful for them.

raj-ops: Command: `redwood keys inspect <key>` returns JSON with org_id, scopes, bound. I'll post the temp key in channel once created and attach audit id.

redwood-bot: New API key created: sk_temp_winco_multi (expires in 1800s)  created by raj-ops  scopes:["generate","embed"]  audit: audit_2076543300_winco

mia-sales: Pasting to customer. They report the 403 and insufficient_scopes errors are gone. They ran a small parallel load and saw a couple 429s. Can ops explain demo rate limits?

ana-eng: Demo keys have conservative concurrency. Recommend client retry with exponential jitter (100ms base, 3 retries). Ops can temporarily bump concurrency for their demo org for the window.

raj-ops: Bumped soft concurrency for org-winco-demo for 30m. Monitoring. Exporting audit log for the temp key to attach to their security questionnaire (they requested SC-03 details).

kevin-ps: I'll follow up with pricing note: demo traffic isn't billed; production is per-token. Also include a blurb for SC-03: key rotation and audit.

mia-sales: Thanks team. Demo back on track. Closing unless they reopen. :sparkles:
